adds.title: Bill C-32 / Bill C-75 - Repeal of Criminal Code s.159 (Royal Assent June 21, 2019)
adds.summary: Effective June 21, 2019, S.C. 2019, c. 25 repealed Criminal Code section 159 and barred conviction for any historical sexual offence unless the act would constitute an offence if committed on the day the charge was laid, thereby eliminating that consensual-sex criminal liability in Quebec.
